question: Unit of pressure is:
solution:
The Correct answer is __**Pascal**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The **Pascal** (Pa) is the **SI unit** of pressure.
 
• It is defined as one **newton per square meter** (N/m²).
 
• The unit is named after the **French mathematician Blaise Pascal**, who made significant contributions to fluid mechanics and the study of pressure.
 
• It is widely used in various fields such as **physics, engineering, and meteorology**.
 
• Common multiples of the Pascal include the **hectopascal (hPa)** and the **kilopascal (kPa)**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

__
 
• **Newton**__

 __
 
• The **Newton (N)** is the **SI unit of force**.
 
• It is named after **Sir Isaac Newton** for his work on the laws of motion.
 
• It is defined as the force required to accelerate a one-kilogram mass by one meter per second squared.
 
 
 
• **Angstrom**__
 
 
• The **Angstrom (Å)** is a unit of length used primarily to express **wavelengths of light**.
 
• One angstrom is equivalent to **10⁻¹⁰ meters** or **0.1 nanometers**.
 
• It is named after the Swedish physicist **Anders Jonas Ångström**.
